title: Batch Geocode input
description: Forward-geocode addresses and/or reverse-geocode coordinates through the OFFICIAL Google Geocoding, Mapbox Geocoding or HERE Geocoding & Search API. Bring your own provider key — without one nothing is sent and every row is free (missing_key).

addresses.title: Addresses (forward geocode)
addresses.description: One address per line, e.g. '1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View, CA'. Duplicates (case-insensitive) are removed.

coordinates.title: Coordinates (reverse geocode)
coordinates.description: Optional. Array of "lat,lng" strings or {"lat": 52.5163, "lng": 13.3777} objects. Out-of-range or malformed values become free invalid_input rows.

datasetId.title: Dataset ID (address list)
datasetId.description: Optional. Read addresses from another Actor's dataset. Uses the field set in 'Address field', else address / fullAddress / query / location / formattedAddress; rows with lat+lng (or latitude+longitude) and no address are reverse-geocoded.

keyValueStoreId.title: Key-value store ID (address list)
keyValueStoreId.description: Optional. Read addresses from a key-value record: JSON array, {"addresses": [...], "coordinates": [...]}, or plain text with one address per line.

keyValueRecordKey.title: Key-value record key
keyValueRecordKey.description: Record key inside the key-value store (default INPUT_ADDRESSES).

addressField.title: Address field (dataset / JSON objects)
addressField.description: Optional. Name of the field holding the address in dataset items or JSON objects.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Which official geocoding API to call with your key.

apiKey.title: Provider API key (required)
apiKey.description: Google: Maps Platform API key with the Geocoding API enabled (+ billing). Mapbox: access token. HERE: REST API key. Stored encrypted and never logged or written to output. WITHOUT a key nothing is sent and rows are failed + free (missing_key).

language.title: Result language
language.description: Optional language code for results, e.g. en, de, zh-TW (Google `language`, Mapbox `language`, HERE `lang`).

region.title: Region bias (Google)
region.description: Optional ccTLD region bias for Google forward geocoding, e.g. uk, de, tw.

mapboxCountry.title: Country filter (Mapbox)
mapboxCountry.description: Optional comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for Mapbox, e.g. us,ca.

limit.title: Results per address
limit.description: Best match goes into the row; extra matches are added to `alternatives` (no extra charge).

enableDistanceMatrix.title: Enable Distance Matrix (Google only)
enableDistanceMatrix.description: Also compute origin × destination distance/duration with the Google Distance Matrix API (your key must have that API enabled). Results go to the MATRIX record and REPORT.md; each OK element is a matrix-element event.

units.title: Units
units.description: Text units for distances (values are always meters / seconds).

maxMatrixElements.title: Max matrix elements
maxMatrixElements.description: Cap on origins × destinations (requests are chunked within Google's 25×25 / 100-element limits).

maxAddresses.title: Max addresses
maxAddresses.description: Stop after this many inputs (addresses + coordinates). 0 = no limit.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retries for 429 / OVER_QUERY_LIMIT (honours Retry-After), 5xx / UNKNOWN_ERROR and timeouts with exponential backoff. 401/403/REQUEST_DENIED/ZERO_RESULTS are not retried.

stopOnAuthError.title: Stop on rejected key
stopOnAuthError.description: After the provider rejects the key (REQUEST_DENIED / 401 / 403 / OVER_DAILY_LIMIT), mark the remaining inputs as failed without sending them (saves your quota). All free.
